name: Hanazono Shion
source:
The soccer team manager. She was one of the first friends Fumiya made after moving to this town.

She comes across as a bit quiet, expressionless, and gloomy, but she’s actually quite the homemaker and positive.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/24250/?gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
